baseline_models.focus_anchor: هو الحق / يحيي الموتى / على كل شيء قدير
baseline_models.mechanism: The three predicates mutually specify one agency: stable reality is recognizable as the agent who reverses loss of life, while كل شيء removes any class of object from that effective capacity.

activation_trace.role: Reality fixed against falsehood supplies the ontological force of الحق and makes it the ground of the following acts.
Possession of living spirit supplies the state restored by the causative verb and makes revival an actual state-change.
Departure of force and life supplies the terminal condition over which vivifying agency operates.
Comprehensive enclosure and totality make the scope exhaustive rather than representative.
Anything knowable or reportable supplies the unrestricted object-domain of the capacity claim.
Effective ability and mastery supply the power that can carry the dead-to-living transition through.

changed_reading.before: The ayah lists that God is true, raises the dead, and is omnipotent.
changed_reading.after: The clauses define truth operationally: the truly real agent is the one whose efficacy crosses the maximal life/death boundary without any object escaping its reach.

baseline_models.mechanism: The measure and planning branches of ق د ر allow قدير to carry calibrated efficacy, while the earth-life and inert-land branches make revival the fitted conversion of unusable matter into a viable state; الحق adds an image of work made firm and exact.

activation_trace.role: Firmly woven work or speech supplies an exploratory image of truth as an achieved, coherent fit.
Earth becoming alive through rain and growth supplies a processual rather than merely punctual image of vivification.
Dead land or inert property supplies matter present but not yet functioning as living productivity.
A thing's measured amount and limit supply the calibration through which each thing reaches its fitting state.
Planning, proportioning, and making firm supply the ordering activity behind the transition into life.

changed_reading.before: Reviving the dead is a sheer display of unlimited force.
changed_reading.after: Reviving can also be heard as exact formative competence: inert material is brought, by fitted measure and ordering, to the state in which life can hold.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human and terrestrial sequences in 22:5 turn calibrated vivification into an observable mechanism: measured formation proceeds through ordered stages, while apparently dead land moves, rises, and grows. This strengthens the focus claim from generic force to power expressed through timed, material transformation.

activation_trace.role: Life of earth by rain and vegetation supplies the latent process image that the preceding ayah makes explicit.
Deliberate proportioning and preparation supply the focus-side capacity for ordered formation.
Measuring and proportioning a created thing organize the embryo's differentiated stages as calibrated formation.
Dried-out lifelessness supplies the earth-side equivalent of the focus ayah's dead condition.
Earth and vegetation stirring with life mark the first visible activation of what had appeared dead.
Nourishment and growth supply the expanding middle phase rather than an instantaneous before-and-after jump.
Vegetation emerging from earth supplies the completed productive outcome of vivification.

structural_cues: 22:5 orders dust, drop, attachment, morsel, gestation, birth, maturity, decline, and death before pairing that human sequence with dry earth, water, motion, swelling, and growth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered developmental stages and a water-driven land sequence; I infer that their gradual calibration specifies how قدير operates in 22:6. A live alternative is that both sequences are only analogical proofs of a later resurrection, without adding a process nuance to قدير itself.

changed_reading.before: God's ability to revive is asserted as an unlimited exception to ordinary death.
changed_reading.after: The ability is displayed inside ordinary formation: power works by bringing material through measured thresholds until dormant or unformed matter becomes visibly alive.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 22:52-54, an intrusive casting is removed, the signs are made firm, and only then are recognized as الحق. The focus declaration can therefore carry a dynamic epistemic mechanism: truth not only remains fixed but exposes, removes, and repairs what is alien to its communication.

activation_trace.role: Reality fixed against falsehood supplies the stable focus anchor that correction preserves.
Removal followed by a replacement supplies the clearing operation applied to the intrusive casting.
Making something exact, firm, and secure supplies the positive consolidation that follows removal.
Establishing and making truth evident supplies the recognized result of the correction sequence.

structural_cues: 22:52 sequences alien casting, divine removal, and divine tightening of the signs; 22:54 names the resulting recognition as الحق and follows it with believing and humbled hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence casting, removal, firming, and recognition as truth; I infer that this sequence enacts the focus predicate هو الحق. The narrower alternative is that the passage describes protection of revelation only and does not modify the semantics of 22:6.

changed_reading.before: هو الحق identifies an already fixed proposition or ontological status.
changed_reading.after: هو الحق can additionally name an active truth-capacity: contamination is made legible, removed, and followed by a firmer, recognizable articulation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The run 22:61-66 places the repeated truth formula amid reciprocal night/day entry, rain-greened earth, the holding of the sky, and life-death-life. It changes the focus triad into continuous governance of thresholds: truthful power does not merely initiate events but admits, converts, restrains, and sustains states.

activation_trace.role: Stable actuality supplies the focus predicate whose operation the later sequence redisplays.
Living spirit supplies one side of the repeatedly governed life/death boundary.
Loss of force and life supplies the opposite state through which the agency passes.
Effective mastery supplies the capacity to maintain as well as reverse states.
One thing entering inside another supplies reciprocal, gradual threshold-crossing rather than abrupt replacement.
The exact repeated truth predicate explicitly identifies the surrounding governance with stable reality.
Idleness and failure of useful action sharpen falsehood as non-operative agency, the inverse of the focus sequence.
Tender green growth supplies a renewed living state produced after rain.
Holding and restraining supply continuous preservation, expanding power beyond acts of initial creation.
Life bestowed before and after death makes the focus reversal into a repeated temporal cycle.
Causatively removing life supplies the intervening transition within the life-death-life sequence.

structural_cues: 22:61 and 22:62 repeat the focus ayah's ذلك بأن construction, and 22:62 repeats هو الحق exactly before 22:63-66 unfold greening, holding, life, death, and renewed life.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated syntax plus several managed transitions; I infer that they are coordinated examples of one sustaining threshold-rule and thus expand the force of قدير. They may alternatively be independent signs collected under a general proof formula.

changed_reading.before: Power is chiefly the ability to perform the exceptional future act of raising the dead.
changed_reading.after: Power is also continuous custody of permeable boundaries: it moves states into one another, keeps destructive possibilities in check, and repeatedly carries life through death.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fly example reduces rival agency to the smallest concrete شيء: the invoked powers cannot create it or recover what it takes. The next ayah joins ق د ر and ح ق ق in حق قدره. Against that pair, the focus's قدير على كل شيء becomes a correction of scale: creatures mismeasure divine capacity by projecting the weakness of sought and seeker onto the true agent.

activation_trace.role: Comprehensive totality makes even the example's minute object part of the focus claim's scope.
The maximally general knowable object supplies the category later instantiated by what the fly takes.
Effective ability and mastery supply the capacity that rivals fail to display.
Bringing a creature into existence supplies the first deliberately failed agency test.
A single unspecified thing supplies a minimal concrete instance of the focus ayah's unrestricted object-domain.
Extracting something from a predicament or another's grasp supplies the second agency test, recovery, that the rivals fail.
The contrary of strength names the shared incapacity of seeker and sought and sets the contrast with قدير.
Measure, amount, and limit supply the doubled q-d-r wording as a diagnosis of failed estimation.
A due and fitting claim supplies the standard of estimation that the failed measurement does not meet.

structural_cues: 22:73 moves from inability to create a fly to inability to retrieve one thing, then 22:74 immediately states that they did not q-d-r God by His true q-d-r and contrasts this with divine strength.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the minute object, two failed agency tests, shared weakness, and the q-d-r/h-q-q collision; I infer that 22:74 diagnoses the conceptual error answered by 22:6. An alternative is that 22:74 rebukes deficient reverence generally, not specifically a mistaken scale-model of capacity.

changed_reading.before: على كل شيء قدير is an abstract maximal attribute.
changed_reading.after: It is also an anti-comparison rule: no creaturely scale, from a fly or stolen trifle upward, is a valid measure for the true agent's capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 22:39-40, قدير is specified as capacity to vindicate those wronged, and divine دفع works through people countering people so that multiple worship spaces are not destroyed. The life-giving power of 22:6 can thus extend functionally into preserving communal and ritual life, not only restarting organisms.

activation_trace.role: Life as benefit, preservation, and rescue supplies the focus-side warrant for a social rather than solely biological extension.
Effective capacity supplies the power that the later passage directs toward protection.
Obtaining redress for the wronged supplies the concrete social object of divine capacity.
The repeated divine-capacity predicate explicitly specializes the focus's قدير as power to support the wronged.
A due and legitimate claim marks the unjust expulsion as lacking any rightful ground.
Pushing away a harmful force supplies the distributed counteraction by which destruction is prevented.
Aid that makes its object prevail supplies reciprocal human-divine participation in preservation.

structural_cues: 22:39 grants action because people were wronged and names God capable of their support; 22:40 gives the counterfactual result of absent دفع as demolished monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies targeted redress, distributed counterforce, and preserved worship sites; I infer that preserving those systems is a social realization of the focus life-as-benefit branch. The live alternative is that this passage illustrates justice and power without activating يحيي semantically.

changed_reading.before: يحيي الموتى concerns the restoration of biologically dead individuals.
changed_reading.after: Without displacing resurrection, the phrase can radiate toward power that keeps vulnerable communities and their practices from being rendered socially dead.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers life/death language from organisms to a ruined settlement, unused infrastructure, and blinded hearts. It remains anchored through the focus inventories' life-as-benefit and dead-property branches and through 22:45-46's explicit emptiness, disuse, and inner blindness. Downstream prose should present it only as a functional analogy, not as the direct referent of الموتى.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يحيي الموتى, with life as restored benefit and deadness as inert property

activation_trace.role: Life as benefit, rescue, and preserved good allows functional vitality to remain anchored in يحيي.
Dead land or property lacking use supplies an explicit non-organic deadness branch anchored in الموتى.
Emptiness and vacancy make the destroyed town present as form without functioning communal life.
Vacancy and disuse make the well an intact resource whose benefit has died.
Intellect restraining ignorance supplies the missing inner function that travel through the ruins is meant to reactivate.
Blindness of heart and insight supplies an epistemic deadness paired with materially unused civic forms.

changed_reading.before: The dead are bodies from which biological life has departed.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the dead can also image forms that remain materially present while benefit and perception have ceased; revival would mean restoring use, understanding, and communal circulation.

strongest_changes: 22:5 converts generic power into staged, measured formation across embryo and earth.
22:52-54 makes truth visible through removal of intrusion and renewed firming.
22:61-66 frames truth as sustained governance of transitions, restraint, and life-death-life.
22:73-74 turns قدير into a rebuke of creaturely measurement through the fly, شيء, and حق قدره.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet does more than repeat the focus claims: it reuses the exact truth formula, specializes قدير in protection, and finally collides the focus roots ح ق ق and ق د ر in a statement about failing to measure God by His true measure.
remaining_uncertainties: The measured and planned senses of ق د ر may be branch activation rather than a direct semantic load of قدير in 22:6.
The corrective-truth sequence may concern revelation specifically rather than defining divine truth generally.
The social and civic-life extensions are coherent but should remain secondary to biological resurrection.
